chain_words.nuance: to put an idea forward gently, without pressing it
to push someone towards an action with support and confidence
to bring someone to accept a view through reasons or argument
to make someone fully believe something, often after resistance
to force someone to act against their will, using pressure or threat

explanation: These words all describe influencing someone's opinion or actions, moving from a gentle suggestion to outright compulsion.

usage_notes.difference: 'Persuade' focuses on the process of influencing someone through reasons; 'convince' focuses on the result, namely that the person has come to believe something.
